entries.source:
This is a trial version of Nimble Commander-Fork.
To continue using this software after the 30-day trial period, you have to either buy a license or install the paid version from Mac App Store.
This window appears only in the trial version.
entries.translation:
Is e seo dreach deuchainn de Nimble Commander-Fork.
Gus leantainn air adhart a’ cleachdadh a’ bhathar-bog seo às deidh na h-ùine deuchainn 30-latha, feumaidh tu cead a cheannach no an dreach pàighte a stàladh bho Mac App Store.
Chan eil an uinneag seo a’ nochdadh ach anns an tionndadh deuchainn.
